Cloudflare said it has already detected some exploitation of the flaw, and that at 3:02 am (UTC) it implemented web application firewall rules to protect websites from attack traffic seeking to exploit the bugs, which could cause a denial of service condition, remote code execution, and data exposure. Experts say there are working exploits for the flaws, and that these critical bugs are already being exploited in the wild. OpenAI , which was involved in the vulnerability research and outreach, said given the severity of these flaws and PHP s widespread use, we consider this one of the most impactful security issues in recent memory. The underlying flaws had been present for decades, but demonstrating their exploitability required an exceptionally complex chain of steps, at the edge of what human researchers could practically achieve.
